key_question: Can defensible measurement descriptors remove nuisance variation without simply allowing the model to memorize dataset identity?
answer_in_this_challenge: NO. The lawful descriptors available (visible depth, measurable-address count) neither remove the operator-linked capture nuisance nor separate the biological world from its operator twin; only raw dataset identity does, and raw identity is an exploratory positive control, never a design.
why: the nuisance is a gene-specific capture bias tied to operators; depth and coverage counts do not measure gene-specific capture, so adjusting for them cannot remove it. A defensible descriptor would have to measure the capture process itself (for example technical spike-ins or protocol and chemistry variables that physically set the capture of these genes), not stand in for which dataset a cell came from

support_count_as_identity_key.reading: the measurable-address count is fixed by source and operator here, so as a lookup key it identifies the operator for almost every cell even though a LINEAR adjustment cannot use it (linear leakage about 0.03). A learned model with any nonlinearity could memorise dataset identity through it; it is not a safe 'lawful' covariate

exact_twin.reading: identical under every arm, raw identity included: the exact twin is tied to state exactly as the biology is, so no context can separate them

raw_identity_cost: residualizing on raw identity lowered biological recoverability from 0.853 to 0.824 even though state is independent of operator in this world; with real study-composition confounding (S149) it would remove more biology
caveats: linear residualization and linear readouts; they understate what a nonlinear model could extract from identity proxies
the operator set reached 571 cells against the state's 366, so the twin copied the program's size only approximately
BIO and TWIN_OPERATOR latents share their noise by design, which produces cross-recoverability near 0.3
the depth and support splits of ARM2 were not pre-registered and are labelled EXPLORATORY_DECOMPOSITION
one realization, seed 7302: DEVELOPMENT_CALIBRATION, never independent confirmation
